integrity: Numerical verification is a finite corroboration; the infinite-angle theorem is justified by the analytic proof and the cited classification theorem.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion uses the published classification of maximal embedded isosceles triangles. It proves the sharp angular minimax and phase transition, not a new pointwise classification. It does not address arbitrary polygons or only equilateral subtriangles. Literature priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Sharp minimum-angle area retention for inscribed isosceles triangles
